name: Suzhou Recodeal Interconnect System Co.,Ltd
summary: Suzhou Recodeal Interconnect System Co.,Ltd operates on a global scale, specializing in the development, manufacturing, and distribution of connection systems, microwave components, and various related items. Their extensive product range includes connectivity solutions for energy vehicles, telecommunications, industrial applications, and vehicle communications, alongside BUSBAR copper bar systems, cable assemblies, and wiring harnesses. These offerings are predominantly deployed within critical sectors such as data communication, the new energy vehicle industry, industrial control, medical equipment, and rail transportation, among other applications. The company, which established its operations in 2006, is headquartered in Suzhou, China.
